topic: Bogdan Draganski (2004) Juggling-Induced Adult Gray-Matter Plasticity in V5/hMT+ & Intraparietal Sulcus, Detraining Reversibility, and Scholz (2009) White-Matter Remodeling (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: Jan Scholz and Heidi Johansen-Berg's 2009 Oxford DTI breakthrough proving that juggling also thickens deep white-matter tracts beneath the intraparietal sulcus by 5%—and that those deep cables persist even after rest.

clips.attire_and_hands: white lab coat sleeves and matte-white gloved low-poly hands over a cool-alabaster desk
clips.prop_action: both matte-white gloved low-poly hands set a heavy gray stone brain cast onto the slate-stone desk and tap its rigid surface with a brushed-silver rod
clips.consequence: the stone brain cast sits motionless in soft daylight

clips.attire_and_hands: white lab coat cuffs and matte-white gloved low-poly hands beside the stone cast
clips.prop_action: one matte-white gloved low-poly hand rolls three soft soft-lavender, yellow, and soft-sage rubber balls across the slate-stone desk until they bump the stone cast
clips.consequence: the three colorful rubber balls settle around the gray stone base

clips.anatomy_label:
PARIETAL & VISUAL MOTION
NEW GRAY MATTER
clips.brain_scene: across the upper-rear parietal and side visual-motion ridges of the matte warm-ivory 3D brain model, warm amber-gold and cyan-blue facets bloom and expand visibly

clips.attire_and_hands: sage sweater sleeves and matte-white gloved low-poly hands extending from the bottom frame edge
clips.prop_action: both matte-white gloved low-poly hands juggle and catch three pastel balls in a crisp criss-cross arc above the sunlit floor
clips.consequence: the three pastel balls trace a clean figure-eight path in mid-air

clips.environment: a sunlit 2004 German neuroimaging laboratory with a cool-white cylindrical MRI scanner and three pastel balls on the pale-pale-stone control desk
clips.action: viewed strictly from behind, a clothed low-poly neurologist in a white lab coat steps beside the viewing console and points at a soft 3D brain scan

clips.attire_and_hands: white lab coat sleeves and matte-white gloved low-poly hands over an antique neurology album
clips.prop_action: both matte-white gloved low-poly hands close the heavy leather cover of the old album and place three pastel juggling balls on top
clips.consequence: the soft rubber balls rest squarely on the closed vintage cover

clips.analogy_world: a sunlit cool-alabaster shelf displaying five pale-gray brain blocks decreasing slightly in size from left to right
clips.comparison_action: two matte-white gloved low-poly hands in coat sleeves lift and slide a brushed-silver measuring caliper down the shrinking row of pale-gray blocks

clips.prop_action: both matte-white gloved low-poly hands press and sculpt a cool-ivory cool-porcelain hemisphere on a pale-gray turntable

clips.action: viewed strictly from behind, clothed low-poly young volunteers in pastel sweaters stand in two neat rows and lift light-gray crates of rubber balls

clips.consequence: the soft-lavender and yellow balls roll gently to a stop by the wall

clips.attire_and_hands: white lab coat sleeves and matte-white gloved low-poly hands over a pale-gray sorting board

clips.attire_and_hands: white lab coat cuffs and matte-white gloved low-poly hands over a backlit 3D voxel grid model

clips.consequence: the caliper tips suddenly spread wider across the expanded ridge

clips.brain_scene: on the matte warm-ivory 3D brain model on its pale-wood stand, the upper-rear intraparietal groove and side visual-motion area glow soft pastel cyan-blue and swell outward

clips.brain_scene: along the upper-rear parietal ridge of the matte warm-ivory 3D brain model, a glowing sky-blue pathway links the rear visual zone forward to the premotor strip

clips.attire_and_hands: sage sweater sleeves and matte-white gloved low-poly hands extending from the bottom frame edge
